question: Does retaining distinct reference hypotheses make language-conditioned joint assignment outperform the same evidence with a fixed reference?
parent_population: All 18,620 ordinary R165 directional records, with the same six directions, source states, prose, RGB, sampled points and target metrics. Consume the already verified ordinary manifests and seals only.
retrieval: Replace R88's early three-reference cutoff at the LCIB readout with up to 32 distinct candidates per involved role. Admit original 3EED candidates and the non-native initial hypotheses already sealed by R166. Require at least two distinct supporting seeds for a reference. Deduplicate by the existing R88 support Jaccard threshold of 0.5 and LCIB normalized center threshold of 0.40. Unsupported roles have an explicit unresolved option. Use the frozen R158 utility for subject unaries. Reference scores average full-pool log-normalized native role-token alignment and the original R88 attention-mass-over-square-root-support score. Non-native query evidence borrows from overlapping native supports with an overlap discount, while its own point-attention evidence is measured directly. Candidate ranking is computed before the explicit relation factor.
same_information: Independent, fixed_reference and joint share every candidate, unary and physical pair score. Independent selects role maxima. Fixed_reference selects reference maxima before allowing the same pair score to select a subject. Joint maximizes exactly over the direct subject-reference star, retaining all supported reference alternatives. r88_ref3_joint varies only reference admission, using the audited older R88 three-item route with the same scoring and subject bank. All arms use R158+PCA on records without a supported direct camera relation.
pair_score: Direct camera LEFT/RIGHT factors use visible seed decile intervals. Signed separation is tanh of midpoint gap divided by max(0.02, half the sum of interval widths), weighted by the geometric mean of the existing R88 projected-cell reliability. Preserve LCIB's overlap penalty shape, measuring Jaccard on shared three-dimensional seed supports. Both factors have unit upper magnitude in the log score units. Each reference may abstain with unary -2 relative to its best physical option. Opposing signs on one edge sum to zero.
geometry: Retain raw centers and sizes or the pre-existing R166 alternative geometry. Apply the common R165 PCA rule at output. No new frame, external model, parameter update or training.
counterfactual: On every row with one unambiguous signed direct relation, hold the entire candidate bank, role scores and scene fixed and reverse just the parsed predicate. Record all changes, missing predictions, and coherence. Truth of the opposite side is evaluated separately in a preregistered, output-blind image panel, with a common visible reference and a distinct independently identified subject on each side. The panel uses the same entity phrases with controlled left/right clauses. This isolates the explicit predicate input, so no claim about contextual language encoder re-encoding is made. Include wrong, nonunique, missing and unknown cases.
metrics: Report strict Acc@25 and Acc@50, mIoU, subject identity and where annotated pair identity on all and parseable direct subsets, six direction means and per direction, with changes in both directions. Use R166's common seed ownership and audit by independent sensor-frame oriented IoU. Use blinded real-pair annotations to measure correct opposite target and same correct reference, separate from a mere change of box. Use the physical recording as inference cluster when reporting a paired interval.
label_boundary: No target box labels, reference labels or predicted task scores may enter retrieval, unary/pair score construction, setting values, or predicate-only prediction. Seal primary and counterfactual predictions before reading identities. Retain all negatives and unresolved predictions. FINAL is excluded by the pinned parent manifests, without opening its files.
adoption: Joint contribution is evaluated against both fixed-reference and independent readout on the same bank. Coverage, relation satisfaction, and sensitivity to a sign reversal are mechanism diagnostics. Claim correct relational grounding only with a task gain and independent identity corroboration. Report mixed directions and largely proxy identity coverage as such.
